title: CHORE — Add SCS-001 generated artifact dirs to .gitignore, untrack cached files
rationale: workspace/scs001/scripts/, workspace/scs001/code-demo-runs/, and workspace/scs001/topic-radar/ are generated per pipeline run. They were tracked in git causing hundreds of D (deleted) entries in git status after each pipeline cleanup cycle. This pollutes git status, slows git operations, and creates noise in commits. Added all 3 dirs to .gitignore and ran git rm --cached -r to stop tracking existing files.

tasks.description: Add workspace/scs001/scripts/, workspace/scs001/code-demo-runs/, workspace/scs001/topic-radar/ to .gitignore. Run git rm --cached -r on all 3 directories to stop tracking. These are generated pipeline output files (dbt-/exp-/lst-/vis-*.json, demo-*/meta.json, radar-*.json) created and deleted each pipeline run.
